title: The fill plan places brief photos by v3 slot role and offering: a card takes only its own offering's photo, general slots only general photos, keep and demo-only slots are never filled
steps: S1: Run node --test packages/wo/website-opportunities/test/domain-fill-plan.test.mjs (a fictional racket club brief with tennis, padel and unsure photos on a trimmed version 3 template map).
S2: Run node --test apps/tracy-web/test/brief-fill-plan-pictures.test.mjs (the Joomla picture phase shapeReal on a version 3 map, and the hand-off's picture summary).
expect: S1: exit 0, no failed or skipped test; padel photos reach only the padel card, unsure photos only general slots, the keep slot and the demo-only entity's slots are never filled, every decision has a reason code.
S2: exit 0, no failed or skipped test; each card's file takes its own offering photo, the demo-only picture is not written, the hand-off lists every picture decision with its reason code.
evidence: Before this change the Joomla picture planner guessed each slot's role from its name and never read which offering a photo shows, so a padel photo could land in the tennis card.
fence: planFill qualifies a photo by its depicts link against the card's locked offering before any shape check; shapeReal uses it for Joomla version 3 maps
